features.name: Two side guide rails beside the backpack's lower tier
features.geometry: vertical guide face to z 12.5, 60 deg lead-in to z 24, 3 mm play per side (gap 53.1 for the 47.1 mm tier), x -77..-59 only, 2.5 mm thick plus base
features.need: Problem 1: the robot sits down off to one side and a pad misses its leaf
features.why: Without rails the sim passes only y -3..0 mm; with rails y -15..0 mm (5 seeds). The tier walls are the only flat, vertical surfaces on the backpack low enough to guide before the pads touch.
features.simpler: Wider leaves or wider pads: the leaf-to-other-leaf gap (y +-9 +-3.5) forbids a wider leaf without shorting risk; pads are fixed on the backpack. A floor V-groove for the feet was rejected because the feet lift off during the sit.
features.validation: MuJoCo grid with the real Brain sit, --model asbuilt --manifest current; rail clearance to legs and feet >= 7 mm in stand, sit and rise
features.change_when: backpack lower-tier width or pad position changes, or the robot test shows a hang on the lead-in

features.name: Datum moved 3 mm forward (stop face and leaves), leaves a further 2.5 mm forward of the stop
features.need: Problem 2: the released A1 leaf tip sits behind the 8.7 mm pad; 0 of 46 sim runs pass on x, even at nominal
features.why: The sim seat is 1.9 deg nose-up, which moves the pad forward of where A1 expects it
features.simpler: Leave A1 as is: fails every case on x
features.validation: x window -6..+3 mm without rails, -9..+3 mm with rails (x -6 fails 1 of 5 seeds)
features.change_when: the real robot's seated pad position is measured on the dock and differs from the sim by more than 1 mm

features.name: 45 deg rear lead-in from the stop face's top edge over the stop wall and tower side walls
features.need: Problem 3: a robot that starts 3 to 6 mm back lands on the stop wall's relief ledge (z 14.6) or the tower top (z 22) and hangs
features.why: A slope turns a landing on top into a slide down to the stop face
features.simpler: A taller stop wall: it would catch the tail higher and still leave a flat top to hang on
features.validation: x -9 start passes with F1 to F3; replaces the screw-head relief ledge, so screw access must be re-checked in CAD
features.change_when: the dock's tower or the screw layout changes

features.name: Rail extent limits: rails end at x -59, below z 24, inside |y| 41
features.need: Problem 4: rails must not touch legs or feet during stand, sit and stand-up
features.why: The left foot comes down at x -51 at the end of the stand-up; legs never come behind x -40 while standing or sitting
features.simpler: Full-length rails: the long-rail variant R3 touched the legs in 8 runs
features.validation: clearance >= 7 mm in stand, sit and rise phases in every R1 run; after the stand-up the sim robot steps back onto the rails (-4 mm), reported as a risk
features.change_when: the stand-up motion or foot placement changes
